name: process-runs
description: Start, watch and steer daemon-owned process runs via `tclaude process`: run (start a saved template, scoped to a group or agent), runs ls, show, events, pause/resume, decide, assign, resolve-blocked, skip-wait, check-now, block, cancel, send-back, amend, reconcile, reissue, record-outcome; oversee a run and raise or answer its concerns (concern, answer-concern, concerns, oversee); report a node you were dispatched; and read event triggers via `tclaude agent triggers ls|show|explain`. Covers the process.runs.read/start/manage and self.process permissions (group ownership confers read and group- or member-scoped start, never manage). Use when asked to run, kick off, monitor, unblock, approve or cancel a process/workflow, when a process node arrives in your inbox, or to see which trigger rule would fire on a PR/CI or agent-state event. Not for authoring or editing templates (that is process-templates), and not for `tclaude agent process`, a group's advisory phase checklist.

findings.excerpt: tclaude process pause <run-id>          # nothing new dispatched; in-flight work finishes
tclaude process reconcile <run-id>                          # what needs it
tclaude process concern <run-id> "CI is red on main" [--node <step>]   # raise one
tclaude process report succeeded --run <run-id> --node <node> --attempt <n> --note "PR #12 is open"
tclaude process run review --group webshop --param pr=42
